title: Arena of Nîmes
scope: The surviving Arena of Nîmes, complete elliptical two-level arcaded facade, pitched circulation ring, seating bowl and central performance ground.
limitations: Individual Roman repairs, reliefs and restored stone profiles are simplified. The interior circulation beyond the open outer bays and the detailed subterranean complex are outside the exterior model.
Seating row placement and heights are interpreted between documented section sizes. Modern temporary event fixtures and crowds are omitted.
